evidence.answer_defining_proposition: 製造所等で危険物取扱作業に従事する危険物取扱者には保安講習受講義務がある。
evidence.tested_misconception: 免状を取得すれば、実際に危険物取扱作業へ従事しても講習義務はない。
evidence.reasoning_path: licensed handler -> actual handling work at facility -> safety training obligation

collision.note: Batch 2 Tier A; distinct from exam and supervisor qualification questions.

independent_review.rationale: Article 13-23 directly supports the safety-training obligation for licensed handlers engaged in work at facilities; distinct lifecycle duty.

director_adjudication.rationale: The independent review correctly applies the 600Q quality-not-quota contract. The 23 accepted candidates cover distinct statutory roles, duties, authorities, temporal boundaries, eligibility routes, enforcement triggers, or emergency obligations.
